notes:
Messages reach you even with the app closed, and the app opens with motion from the first frame.

- **Messages now send real system notifications.** A WhatsApp-style alert with sound arrives even when Bitify is in the background. Tap it to open the app straight into that conversation. Muted chats stay quiet, a conversation you are already reading does not buzz, and marking it read clears the alert.
- **A new cold-start splash that moves from the very first frame.** The equaliser mark, the Bitify name and the three dots are all there from the start, breathing together in one calm rhythm. No logo background swap, tighter spacing, and the same picture in Android 12+'s system splash.
- **The update popup has been rebuilt.** Live download percentage with a progress bar, a clean What's New panel, Download & Update and Remind Me Later, retry or releases-page links on failure, and an automatic hand-off to the installer when the file is ready.
- **First-run Terms & Conditions** gate a brand-new install before anything else.
- **Admin controls ship in this build**, so the server Bitify talks to can be chosen from the local admin panel.
